text_block_list.text:
The echoing cheers of the crowd at the

Nakayama Racecourse herald the
opening of the
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Having come to the realization that she
would not
be here on luck alone,
Matikanefukukitaru vows
to give the
race everything she has.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She steps forth to take on the Arima

Kinen—carrying the hope that running
with all her
might will turn her into a
lucky Umamusume who
brings joy to all.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
